subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat area capture and focused-app text context

question: Should Quick Chat ship focused-app Accessibility text as an agent attachment with the proposed permission prompt and compact removable chip, or should its consent/preview behavior be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The code deliberately introduces a new path from another app's Accessibility-visible text into an agent request; correctness tests cannot choose the intended user-consent and privacy product boundary.

options.title: Approve the bounded capture model
options.body: Keep the user-initiated permission-gated capture design after the functional defects are fixed and native evidence demonstrates cancellation, denial, and no persistence.

options.title: Require stronger preview or confirmation
options.body: Require the full captured text or a more explicit per-capture confirmation before it can be attached to an outgoing agent message.

options.title: Land area capture only
options.body: Split or defer focused-text capture while keeping the independently useful region-capture work.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded capture model
recommendation.body: Keep the user-initiated permission-gated capture design after the functional defects are fixed and native evidence demonstrates cancellation, denial, and no persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR and authored the current macOS Quick Chat capture implementation.
